rationale: SimPy exposes natural module-level ownership across environment scheduling, event lifecycle, resources, and realtime utilities. Events consume scheduler ordering and exception propagation, resources consume event triggering and process resumption, and realtime helpers consume the shared environment API. These dependencies can fail semantically after clean integration and are supported by public subsystem tests without bootstrap overlays.
